# Replace the roller mop

[All care guides](README.md)

![Replace the roller mop](../img/wash_dock--roller.svg)

**What it does**

A worn roller mop no longer presses evenly on the floor and leaves streaks.

**How to**

1. Take the roller mop off the robot.
2. Fit the new roller until it clicks on both sides.
3. Mark the roller mop as replaced.

> **Note** Let a washed roller dry before it goes back on.
